response.sql:
SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_rate_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM fees
WHERE feerate >= 0.0009
  AND rebrate IS NOT NULL
  AND feerate IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: “High fee-rate band” means feerate at or above the 0.0009 cutoff; records missing either rate are excluded from both the average and count.
